newsitem.title: USA: Air & Water in wastewater treatment deal.
newsitem.headline: Air & Water in wastewater treatment deal.

text.p: Air & Water Technologies Corp Monday said Professional Services Group and Metcalf & Eddy, two of its subsidiaries, are parties to the a major U.S. public-private partnership for municipal water/wastewater treatment.

The $400 million transaction involves a $48 million payment to the city of Cranston, R.I., by Poseidon Resources, the lessee of the facility, which will be used to retire debt and to generate cash for the city's sewer enterprise fund.

Professional Services Group will provide operation, maintenance and management services for the entire treatment system. The value of the contract is about $5.7 million per year over the 25-year contract term.
Metcalf & Eddy will provide design and building services for capital improvements and a treatment facility upgrade. The value of this contract is about $15 million.
